# Tarun Tomar — Resume Source Data

> Source data for tarat.space/resume. Do not fabricate facts beyond what is listed here.

## Contact

- Name: Tarun Tomar (Tarat)
- Location: India (relocating to Edinburgh, UK — September 2026)
- Email: tomartarun2001@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.tarat.space
- YouTube: 4.3K subscribers, monetized
- Twitter/X: @tarat_211
- GitHub: https://github.com/TarunTomar122
- Instagram: 240 followers (ultra running + fitness)

## Summary

Design Engineer at Adobe building design systems used by thousands of engineers across Firefly, Illustrator Web, and Adobe.com. Builder of on-device AI systems, embodied-AI experiments, and indie products with real users and revenue. B.Tech CS from IIT Jodhpur. Starting MSc Artificial Intelligence at University of Edinburgh (Sep 2026). Targeting embodied AI / VLA engineering roles.

Personality for tone: direct, builder-first, competitive, high-agency. Hates generic fluff. Ultramarathon runner.

## Education

- MSc Artificial Intelligence — University of Edinburgh — Sep 2026 – Sep 2027 (incoming)
- B.Tech Computer Science — IIT Jodhpur — Graduated May 2023 — CGPA 8.0/10

## Experience

### Adobe — Design Engineer (SDE II)
June 2023 – Present | Remote / India

- Led architectural migration of Spectrum Web Components to Spectrum 2.0 — impacted Firefly, Illustrator Web, Adobe.com, thousands of engineers
- Built App Frame component from scratch — cross-platform rendering, WCAG accessibility, design consistency
- Built internal tooling to track component adoption across Adobe ecosystem
- Promoted to SDE II (Design Engineer) — Jan 2025
- Stack: Web Components, React, TypeScript, Design Systems, Accessibility, Performance Optimization

### Adobe — Emerging Tech Intern
May 2022 – July 2022

- Built multimodal GenAI assistant for Adobe Express — automated template matching, context-aware canvas editing, asset generation

## Technical Skills

### Fullstack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, React Native, Web Components, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Python, REST APIs, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, AWS, Git, CI/CD, real-time systems

### AI / ML
PyTorch, LoRA/PEFT, PyTorch Mobile, Vision-Language Models, multimodal architectures, LangChain, RAG, HuggingFace, on-device deployment, inference optimization, reinforcement learning

### Honest gaps (do not oversell)
Probabilistic/Bayesian ML depth, distributed training at scale, published research papers

## Featured Projects

### Lumi — On-Device LLM Todo App
https://www.tarat.space/projects/lumi
- 350M param on-device LLM for Android, <100ms inference, LoRA fine-tuned
- 400+ users on Google Play
- Offline-first task manager with natural language input
- Launched Jun 2025; first paid user Sep 2025

### NanoChat / Vision-Enhanced Context Extension
https://www.tarat.space/projects/deepseek-nanochat-1
- Extended small LLM context via BLIP-2 + custom 1.5M param projection layer
- 64× visual token compression for multimodal context
- Google AI Devs reposted the experiment (Aug 2025)
- GitHub: https://github.com/TarunTomar122/vision-encoded-nanochat

### Garden RAG — AI Assistant for Digital Garden
https://www.tarat.space/projects/garden-rag
- Client-side RAG with semantic search over writings, projects, experience
- Live at https://www.tarat.space/tarat-ai

### StocksBrew — AI Stock News Newsletter
https://www.tarat.space/projects/stocksbrew
- Daily AI-curated stock briefings before market open
- $18/month MRR — https://stocksbrew.online
- Stock sentiment prediction side project

### YourTrace — Daily AI/Tech Briefing
https://yourtrace.online
- $28/month MRR
- Product Hunt #7 launch, $50 MRR in first week (Jan 2026)
- Mobile app: 200+ downloads

### Instafy — One-Click Photo Aesthetic Transfer
https://www.tarat.space/projects/instafy
- Upload reference photo, copy color grading to your images
- https://instafy.in/

### Collaborative AI Agents — Multi-Agent RL
https://www.tarat.space/projects/collaborative-ai-agents
- Two RL agents learning to trap a player in grid-world

### Own Transformer — Built from Scratch
https://www.tarat.space/projects/own-transformer
- Coded transformer block from scratch in PyTorch without AI assistance

### ML-DL Implementation Library — Open Source
https://www.tarat.space/projects/ml-implementation
- Python ML library from scratch, 30+ contributors worldwide
- GitHub: https://github.com/RoboticsClubIITJ/ML-DL-implementation

### Other Projects
- Tiny Model Coach — 270M Gemma fine-tuned on Strava data for running coach
- Lumi Voice Assistant — 350M on-device voice todo app
- OOD / Project Nimbus — AI-powered UX flow design canvas
- Trip Planner — Map-based AI trip planner
- Spotify Reels — Spotify reels experience
- Anime Recommendation — Collaborative filtering on 100K MyAnimeList users
- CLI Assistant — Terminal AI assistant with RASA
- YouTube Shorts Automation — Automated shorts from popular video segments
- Digital Garden — This website, perfect Lighthouse score, PPR + SSR hybrid

## Products & Revenue

- YourTrace: $28/month MRR
- StocksBrew: $18/month MRR
- Total baseline: ~$66–76/month
- Lumi: 400+ Play Store users, paid conversions

## Content & Community

- YouTube: 4.3K subscribers, monetized (May 2026), software engineering / AI / startups focus
- First sponsored YouTube video (Apr 2026)
- Instagram: ultra running, fitness — finished ultramarathon 51km in 6:47 (Dec 2025), marathon PB 4:23 (Feb 2026)

## Career Direction (context only — optional on resume)

- Target: Embodied AI Engineer / ML for Robotics (VLA models, on-device inference)
- Target companies: Wayve, National Robotarium, CMR Surgical, Physical Intelligence
- MSc dissertation direction: Visual context compression for real-time VLA inference

## Links

- Portfolio: https://www.tarat.space
- Projects: https://www.tarat.space/projects
- Writings: https://www.tarat.space/writings
- Timeline: https://www.tarat.space/timeline
- Startups: https://www.tarat.space/startups
